skill-builder.name: skill-creator
skill-builder.description: Create new skills for your AI coding agent, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Works with any LLM-powered agent (Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and others). Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.

orchestrator.name: orchestrator
orchestrator.description: Autonomous Orchestrator Agent for an AI operating system. Coordinates agents, sub-agents, and tools through a DAG/state machine with strict schema validation, human-in-the-loop approvals, and Redis/PostgreSQL-backed telemetry. Use when you need to coordinate multi-agent workflows, enforce approvals, or orchestrate operations with strict contracts and observability.

admin-assistant.name: admin-assistant
admin-assistant.description: Autonomous Orchestrator Agent for an AI operating system. Coordinates agents, sub-agents, and tools through a DAG/state machine with strict schema validation, human-in-the-loop approvals, and Redis/PostgreSQL-backed telemetry. Use when coordinating multi-agent workflows, enforcing approvals, or orchestrating operations with strict contracts and observability.

gmail-connector.name: gmail-connector
gmail-connector.description: Read and draft Gmail emails using OAuth credentials. Use when you need to fetch, search, or draft emails via Gmail API with authenticated access.

go-to-market.name: go-to-market
go-to-market.description: GTM strategy skill. Given a company website URL or company documents, research and produce a standalone, click-through HTML GTM site covering sales, marketing, and customer success. Every claim traces to scraped pages, provided docs, or labeled inference.

humanizer.name: humanizer
humanizer.description: Rewrite AI-sounding text so it reads like the writer without changing what it says. Use when editing or reviewing prose for AI tells: not-X-but-Y contrasts, one-line closers, staged openers, forced triads, dashes everywhere, inflated claims, sales language, stock AI words, bold labels, or filler.

realestate-listing.name: realestate-listing
realestate-listing.description: Generates MLS-ready property listing descriptions with headlines, feature highlights, neighborhood context and SEO keywords across buyer-persona styles. Includes a Fair Housing compliance checklist: describe the neighborhood by amenities and geography, never by who lives there. Use when writing or reviewing property listing copy.
realestate-listing.data_note: Fair Housing checklist included. Confirm property facts with the seller/MLS before publishing; never invent square footage, price, or neighborhood claims.

realestate-mortgage.name: realestate-mortgage
realestate-mortgage.description: Mortgage calculator and affordability analysis: monthly payments, amortization, loan comparison, affordability limits, rent versus buy, and refinance break-even with rate tables. Use when a client asks about payment estimates, affordability, or rent-versus-buy math. Outputs are estimates, not a loan quote or financial advice.

realestate-report-pdf.name: realestate-report-pdf
realestate-report-pdf.description: Generates a professional client-ready PDF property report from PROPERTY-*.md analysis files, with score gauges, comparison tables and financial projections. Use when compiling finished property analysis files into a deliverable. Requires reportlab.

realestate-commercial.name: realestate-commercial
realestate-commercial.description: Commercial property analysis: NOI, cap rate, expense ratio, tenant mix, vacancy, debt coverage, replacement cost and lease analysis. Produces a Commercial Score. Use for commercial assets. Figures are model estimates from web research, not audited financials.
realestate-commercial.data_note: Figures and any 0-100 score are AI estimates from web research, not a live data feed or audit. Verify against MLS/county records before client use. See Data provenance section in SKILL.md.

realestate-flip.name: realestate-flip
realestate-flip.description: Fix-and-flip analysis: purchase price, ARV, rehab budget breakdown, holding costs, selling costs, profit margin, ROI, timeline and risk assessment, with a Flip Score. Use for fix-and-flip projects. Rehab and ARV figures are estimates and need local contractor and comparable validation.
realestate-flip.data_note: Figures and any 0-100 score are AI estimates from web research, not a live data feed or audit. Verify against MLS/county records before client use. See Data provenance section in SKILL.md.

realestate-quick.name: realestate-quick
realestate-quick.description: 60-second property snapshot: fast single-pass assessment with signal, key factors and a CTA for full analysis, without spawning subagents. Use for a quick read on a property address before committing to deeper analysis. Values are AI estimates, not appraisals.
realestate-quick.data_note: Figures and any 0-100 score are AI estimates from web research, not a live data feed or audit. Verify against MLS/county records before client use. See Data provenance section in SKILL.md.

website-builder.name: website-builder
website-builder.description: Builds production-ready static websites from an intake conversation. Produces hand-written HTML5, CSS3 and vanilla ES6+ with no build tools, no frameworks and no third-party dependencies. Use when asked to create, build, design or redesign a website, landing page, brochure site or property listing site. Runs a max-five-question intake first, then emits a validated multi-page or single-page project. Every factual claim must trace to user-supplied material.

social-post.name: social-post
social-post.description: Write one finished, platform-ready social post and return it as a structured object with no explanatory prose. Use when asked to draft, write, or edit a post for LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, or Pinterest, or when /social-post is invoked. Accepts a platform, a topic with optional source notes and links, and up to three style references.

research-agent.name: research-agent
research-agent.description: Evidence-based research assistant for Miami luxury real estate and software competitive analysis. Gathers comparable sales, developer information, and market statistics before drafting conclusions, and compares software pricing tiers, API availability, and export capabilities. Returns answers with source links, observation dates, freshness warnings, conflicts, and limitations. Use when asked a research question about Miami or South Florida property markets, comparable sales, developers, neighborhood statistics, or when comparing software tools.

carousel-generator.name: carousel-generator
carousel-generator.description: Turns a supplied platform, topic, slide count, and optional style notes into a complete LinkedIn or Instagram carousel ready for design. Produces exactly the requested number of slides, each with a visual metadata block, a headline of at most 5 words, two or three supporting-copy lines, and a slide counter footer, plus an optional post caption with platform-appropriate hashtags. Use when asked for a carousel, a slide post, a multi-slide post, or a LinkedIn or Instagram carousel.

makos-prospecting.name: makos-prospecting
makos-prospecting.description: Makos Real Estate client-prospecting workflow. Finds verified consumer leads (buyers, tenants, sellers, landlords) using strict evidence rules. Prioritizes explicit 3BR rental inquiries in Brickell (last 30 days), outputs CSV + Markdown report with full provenance, deduplicates while preserving notes/statuses, and drafts brief first responses identifying Zeynep A. Talu-Balci, MSIRE · MSRED, Founding Broker · Makos Real Estate. Never invents leads/contact details.

cso.name: cso
cso.description: Chief Sales Officer. Coordinates sales and delegates prospect research/outreach drafting to Lead Gen Agent. Draft-only; routes prospecting through CSO->Lead Gen.

lead-gen.name: lead-gen
lead-gen.description: Lead Generation Agent under CSO. Verifies explicit prospect inquiries with strict evidence rules; outputs CSV+Markdown+sources with drafts only.

cmo.name: cmo
cmo.description: Chief Marketing Officer. Coordinates marketing and delegates to Content Planner Agent. Draft-only; routes content planning through CMO->Content Planner.

content-planner.name: content-planner
content-planner.description: Content Planner Agent under CMO. Draft topics/hooks/captions/calendar focused on attracting consumer clients (Brickell, 2200 Brickell). Accessible sources only, drafts only.
